```python
# Parse the response to get restaurant names.

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List

class RestaurantList(BaseModel):
    restaurants: List[str]

    f"Extract the list of restaurant names from the following text: {all_restaurants_response}",
    RestaurantList
)

restaurant_names = parsed_restaurants.restaurants

# Get cuisine types for all these restaurants

# Use AI to filter for French cuisine
class FrenchRestaurantFilter(BaseModel):
    french_restaurants: List[str]

    f"From the following dictionary of restaurant names and their cuisine types, identify the restaurants that serve French cuisine. Return only the names of the French restaurants.\n{cuisine_response}",
    FrenchRestaurantFilter
)

french_restaurant_names = french_filter.french_restaurants

# If no French restaurants found, raise error
if not french_restaurant_names:
    raise ValueError("No French restaurants found in Paris.")

# Get opening hours for French restaurants
hours_response = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_restaurant_names)

# Use AI to filter for restaurants open on Sunday
class OpenOnSundayFilter(BaseModel):
    open_restaurants: List[str]

open_filter = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following dictionary of restaurant names and their opening hours, identify the restaurants that are open on Sunday. Return only the names of the restaurants open on Sunday.\n{hours_response}",
    OpenOnSundayFilter
)

open_french_restaurant_names = open_filter.open_restaurants

# If no restaurants open on Sunday, raise error
if not open_french_restaurant_names:
    raise ValueError("No French restaurants found open on Sunday.")

# Get ratings for the open French restaurants
ratings_response = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(open_french_restaurant_names)

# Use AI to find the best rated restaurant
class BestRestaurant(BaseModel):
    best_restaurant_name: str
    rating: str

best_restaurant_filter = query_ai_assistant(
    f"From the following dictionary of restaurant names and their ratings/reviews, identify the restaurant with the best rating. Return the name of the restaurant and its rating.\n{ratings_response}",
    BestRestaurant
)

best_restaurant_name = best_restaurant_filter.best_restaurant_name
best_rating = best_restaurant_filter.rating

# Get address for the best restaurant
address_response = get_restaurants_address([best_restaurant_name])

# Get specific opening hours for the best restaurant to include in the final answer
# We need to re-query the hours for just this one to get the specific string if the previous one was a dict
best_restaurant_hours = hours_response.get(best_restaurant_name, "Hours not available")

# Construct the final response
result = {
    "name": best_restaurant_name,
    "rating": best_rating,
    "address": address_response.get(best_restaurant_name, "Address not available"),
    "hours": best_restaurant_hours
}

print(result)
```
